messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content: 抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的網球排名。若您需要最新資訊，建議查看官方 ATP 或 WTA 排名網站或相關體育新聞來源。

That function is for sports team standings, not individual players. There's no function for individual player ranking. So we cannot use function. We can answer based on knowledge. As of 2026, we need current ranking. But we don't have up-to-date data. We can say we don't have real-time data. We can provide approximate or say we can't fetch. According to policy, we should not hallucinate. So we should respond that we don't have real-time data.
